name: Semjén (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Semjén: a crowned blue shield with a yellow fleur-de-lis and a plant, between ears of grain and reeds, above a scroll inscribed SEMJÉN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Semjén arms with crown, grain and scroll
